newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank denies report of Loyola resignation.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank denies report of Loyola resignation.

text.p: The Brazilian Central Bank denied a newspaper report that its president Gustavo Loyola would quit by January.
"There is absolutely no truth to the report," said a Central Bank spokesman. "(Loyola) has no intention of leaving the bank."

Columnist Cristina Lobo, writing in Wednesday's edition of newspaper O Estado de Sao Paulo, said President Fernando Henrique Cardoso and Finance Minister Pedro Malan had agreed Loyola would leave the bank in December or January.
Possible replacements included current Central Bank directors Gustavo Franco and Francisco Lopes and former president Ibrahim Eris, Lobo said.
Speculation over Loyola's future has been raised several times since he took over the bank in June 1995.
